title: Revibed
description: A polished redesign of default textures for an enhanced Vanilla aesthetic. A fresh look at default textures for instant block identification. A faithful retexture that perfectly balances nostalgia with modern design.
body:
### A polished redesign of default textures for an enhanced Vanilla aesthetic. A fresh look at default textures for instant block identification.
![Revibed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a20ebe09912b543236f9a5ab5ead79c04dd9ba8c_0.webp)

[Discord](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revibed/settings/description) [Twitter/X](https://x.com/BlockSumo)

### Revibed
Revibed is born from a simple idea: keeping the Minecraft we all know and love, but making it look crisper, cleaner, and more polished. It is not about changing the core identity of the game. Instead, it offers a beautifully fresh artistic take on the default blocks while respecting the original color palettes.

### Work in Progress
Please note that Revibed is an ongoing project and is currently in active development.

Not all textures have been completely remade yet. The pack will receive regular updates over time to progressively cover more blocks, items, and environments. By downloading it now, you get to experience the enhanced aesthetic early and follow the journey of the project!

### Feedback
Enjoying the new vibe? Feel free to share your thoughts, report any visual issues, or suggest improvements as the pack continues to grow. --> [Discord](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/revibed/settings/description)
